name: ServiceabilityAddressChecker
tagline: Is this address serviceable? Technology, speeds, products and interest registration in one Power Platform app.
description: Complete telecom address qualification and coverage app for Canvas, Model-driven and Power Pages: type-ahead address check, Serviceable now / Coming soon / Not serviceable result, max speeds, eligible products with Start order, interest registration with consent, coverage dashboard, premises grid, schematic coverage map, build pipeline and demand / notify-when-live view.
features: Type-ahead address, postcode and UPRN search
Product eligibility by technology and speed
Build status workflow with required fields
Bulk actions with undo and CSV export
Phone layout with bottom view bar
controlType: standard (2 controls: ServiceabilityAddressChecker data-set + ServiceabilityAddressCheckerPortal field control, shared src/app)
